definition: A vocabulary for describing the structure, types, and constraints of JSON data, often used to define expected formats for structured model outputs or tool arguments.
details: JSON Schema is widely used in AI engineering to specify the exact shape of data a model should produce or a tool expects, enabling validation and more reliable structured output generation.
story: Picture a potter shaping clay on a spinning wheel: every nudge is tiny, but each one is guided by how the last attempt wobbled. Underneath all the magic is a patient process of small improvements. The machine starts out clumsy, makes mistakes, and is nudged a little less wrong every time. Each pass is a tiny course-correction — the model gets a little less wrong every time. And that is JSON Schema — the quiet loop that turns flailing into skill.
